en:
Welcome in {worldName}, {masterName}.

Explore the world, build yourself an empire, catch the most difficult Bestia.
The world ahead is yours to explore.

Good luck! You will need it.
Well met, traveller. I have nothing to offer you yet - come back once I do.

Open your Skills window. The first thing there is [b]Basic Skill[/b], and almost nothing else opens until it does.

[table=2]
[cell]Lv. 1[/cell][cell]Trade with other players[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 2[/cell][cell]Speak - every channel, including the one around you[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 3[/cell][cell]Use trade posts[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 4[/cell][cell]Recover twice as fast while sitting[/cell]
[cell]Lv. 5[/cell][cell]Form parties, and perform the Master Ritual[/cell]
[/table]

You start with three points. You earn one more every time you gain a level, and where they go is the only thing about your Master that nobody else decides.

Trade posts and sitting are not built yet, so those two ranks buy nothing today.
